title: Broadcasting and batched tensor operations
summary: Write four batched tensor operations without Python loops: per-channel normalization, one-hot encoding, batched outer products and a masked mean.

mutants.wrong_axis_broadcast: Broadcasts the channel statistics on the last axis and not on the channel axis.
mutants.no_range_check: Does not check the labels, so a negative label wraps to the last column.
mutants.outer_transposed: Swaps the axes of the outer product, so each example is transposed.
mutants.mean_over_all_steps: Divides by the sequence length and not by the number of valid steps.
mutants.no_empty_guard: Divides by zero for an example without a valid step and gives NaN.
